paper_id: Mitigating Task Interference in Multi-Task Learning via Explicit Task Routing with Non-Learnable Primitives
title: Mitigating Task Interference in Multi-Task Learning via Explicit Task Routing with Non-Learnable Primitives
motivation: Multi-task networks learn fast initially then degrade due to conflicting gradients from task interference
problem_framing: 现有MTL方法有两个局限：参数全可学习且共享方式隐式无直接控制
key_insight: 用非可学习原语提取任务无关特征 + 显式任务路由控制共享vs专有参数配比
method_signature: ETR-NLP模块: 非可学习原语并行提取多样特征 + 共享/专有分支显式分离
evaluation_criteria: F-score(mIoU) + Δp相对提升 + 参数量/FLOPs对比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 单类型NLP导致性能下降；γ=1(全共享)导致性能受损；不同任务类型需不同训练策略
evidence_for_taste: a single type of NLP does not benefit MTL
using more NLPs generally leads to better MTL performance
performance starts degrading on further training
thinking_moves: 从学习曲线追踪性能退化诊断任务干扰根源
系统枚举31种NLP组合确定最优配置
引入γ参数将共享比例显式化以精确控制
观察梯度方向差异验证干扰假设
